title: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows… (CVE-2026-97892)
description: A vulnerability in LibreOffice's PDF digital signature verification allows an out-of-bounds write due to improper validation of signature coverage against the file size. This flaw can cause memory corruption when opening crafted PDF documents with malicious signatures. The issue is addressed in fixed versions by rejecting signatures that claim to cover data beyond the file boundaries.
